page.notes: The head line "De Durationeentium" is printed with a missing space ("Durationeentium"); transcribed as printed, and the "e" in "Duratione" is a visible Cyrillic-looking glyph in the scan, so the word is marked as printed. Entry 1 "ens[?]" is unclear in the scan (reads like "çns"). Entry 13 "creatis[?]" is doubtful (reads like "creatu"). The entry in line 9 of the second list is cut off at the bottom of the page. No page number is printed at the head or foot of this page, so none is given. The "ibid." entries are as printed.
